Continue to Washington D.C., the capital of the United States, to see the U.S. Capitol and the National Archives (optional), the White House from outside, the Lincoln Memorial and the Vietnam Veterans Memorial. Then continue to Watkins Glen State Park and the Finger Lakes region (optional, seasonal). Arrive at Niagara Falls in the late afternoon and enjoy the spectacular illuminated falls on the Niagara Falls Night View Tour.

Then visit Quincy Market, one of Boston's famous landmarks, to shop for souvenirs and try local food (optional). Afterwards, you will be taken to the airport for your flight home. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. See you on your next journey.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL MELBOURNE – MELBOURNE CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: On arrival at Melbourne Airport, your driver/guide will meet you and take you into central Melbourne. Enjoy a Melbourne City Tour starting at Fitzroy Gardens, a historic park and one of the city's iconic green spaces. Pass St Patrick's Cathedral, the Royal Exhibition Building and Federation Square, a modern landmark at the heart of the city's cultural life. Continue past the Arts Centre, the Shrine of Remembrance, Melbourne Town Hall and Parliament House, which show the city's culture, history and government. Then visit Queen Victoria Market, Melbourne's iconic market with local produce, food and a traditional market atmosphere. Queen Victoria Market is closed on Mondays and Wednesdays; on those days South Melbourne Market is visited instead. Continue to Hosier Lane, a famous street-art lane full of murals and urban art and one of Melbourne's most unique photo spots. After the city tour, go to the hotel to check in (from 3 pm) and enjoy free time to rest or explore the area. Note: • Service is limited to 10 hours or until 8 pm, whichever comes first. • Includes a driver-cum-guide with basic commentary. • The driver stays with the coach for most of the trip.

itinerary.title: GREAT OCEAN ROAD ADVENTURE
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, head for the Great Ocean Road, one of Australia's most famous scenic coastal drives with spectacular coastal views. Drive through charming seaside towns such as Torquay, Lorne and Apollo Bay before continuing to Port Campbell National Park. See the iconic Twelve Apostles, majestic limestone stacks standing in the Southern Ocean. Continue to Loch Ard Gorge, a dramatic stretch of coast with rock cliffs, a beach and stunning sea views. Then stop for photos at the Great Ocean Road Eastern Memorial Arch and enjoy a self-guided Koala Walk at Kennett River, known as a habitat of wild koalas. After enjoying the Great Ocean Road, return to Melbourne. Note: • Coach service is limited to 12 hours. • Includes a driver-cum-guide with basic commentary. • The driver stays with the coach for most of the trip.

itinerary.title: BRIGHTON BEACH – MARU PARK – PHILLIP ISLAND TOUR
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, start the day at Brighton Beach, Melbourne's iconic shoreline famous for its colourful bathing boxes, a favourite photo spot. Continue to Maru Koala & Animal Park for a closer look at native Australian wildlife. Enjoy animal talks and shows, plus a round of Pirate Mini-Golf, a fun addition for families. Then visit the Phillip Island Chocolate Factory for a fun chocolate experience, including 1 small souvenir chocolate bar per person. In the late afternoon, continue to Phillip Island Nature Parks to see one of Australia's most iconic wildlife events, the Penguin Parade. Watch hundreds of little penguins return to shore after a day of feeding at sea, a unique experience and the highlight of the day. After the Penguin Parade, return to Melbourne. Note: • Includes a driver-cum-guide with basic commentary. • The driver stays with the coach for most of the trip.

itinerary.title: MELBOURNE FREE TIME
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then free time to enjoy Melbourne at your own pace.

itinerary.title: MELBOURNE – DEPARTURE
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then check out and transfer to Melbourne International Airport for your flight back to Jakarta. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. We hope you take home wonderful, unforgettable memories. See you on your next journey.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL SYDNEY – SYDNEY CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: On arrival at Sydney Airport, your driver-cum-guide will meet you and start your first taste of Sydney with a Sydney City Tour. Pass the city's icons such as the Sydney Harbour Bridge, Darling Harbour, The Rocks and Kings Cross. Then head to Chinatown and the Sydney Opera House to see the exterior of one of Australia's most iconic landmarks. Enjoy the beautiful harbour view from Mrs Macquarie's Chair, one of the best spots for photos with the Opera House and Harbour Bridge behind you. Continue to Bondi Beach, the famous beach that is an icon of the Sydney lifestyle. Then visit the Sydney Fish Market, one of the city's best-known seafood destinations, before going on to Paddy's Market (closed Mondays and Tuesdays) and the Queen Victoria Building (QVB), a historic shopping centre with elegant classic architecture. After the city tour you will be taken to the hotel to check in (from 3 pm). The rest of the day is free to rest or explore Sydney on your own. Note: • Service is limited to 10 hours or until 8 pm, whichever comes first. • Includes a driver-cum-guide with basic commentary. • The driver stays with the coach for most of the trip. • Paddy's Market is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.

itinerary.title: BLUE MOUNTAINS SIGHTSEEING
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, meet your driver-cum-guide and set off for the Blue Mountains to enjoy one of Australia's iconic mountain landscapes. Start with a visit to Sydney Zoo at Eastern Creek, then continue to Leura Village, a charming mountain village with boutique shops and a peaceful atmosphere. Then head to Katoomba and Echo Point Lookout for spectacular views of the Three Sisters, the iconic rock formation rising above the Jamison Valley. Enjoy Scenic World Blue Mountains with the Ultimate Discovery Pass, including unlimited rides on the Scenic Railway, Skyway and Cableway, with views of the Blue Mountains from every angle. After the tour, return to Sydney. Note: • Coach service is limited to 10 hours. • Includes a driver-cum-guide with basic commentary. • The driver stays with the coach for most of the trip.

itinerary.title: SYDNEY – CANBERRA EXPLORATION – SYDNEY
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, meet your driver-cum-guide and travel to Canberra, Australia's capital, known for its government landmarks and its modern, well-planned layout. In Canberra, enjoy a city tour visiting the Australian War Memorial, Parliament House and a museum, and passing the Prime Minister's Lodge. Continue along Lakeside Drive through Embassy Row, then up to Mt Ainslie Summit (time permitting) for a panoramic view of the city. Before returning to Sydney, enjoy some shopping at Canberra Outlet Centre, with a wide choice of fashion, lifestyle and other goods. After the tour, return to Sydney. Note: • Coach service is limited to 12 hours. • Includes a driver-cum-guide with basic commentary. • The driver stays with the coach for most of the trip.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL DUBAI
itinerary.text: On arrival at Dubai International Airport, you will be taken to the hotel to check in.

itinerary.title: OLD DUBAI HERITAGE & DESERT SAFARI ADVENTURE
itinerary.text: After breakfast, join a Half Day Dubai City Tour. Start by exploring the charm of Old Dubai at Al Seef and Al Bastakiya, then ride an abra water taxi across Dubai Creek to the Spice Souk and Gold Souk, the perfect place to feel Dubai's traditional trading atmosphere. In the afternoon, get ready for an exciting Desert Safari Adventure. Enjoy dune bashing in a 4x4 across the desert, try a camel ride and enjoy a BBQ dinner at an Arabian desert camp. The evening comes with belly dance and Tanoura dance shows, plus henna design and shisha. In the evening, you will be taken back to the hotel. Overnight in Dubai.

itinerary.title: ICONIC DUBAI & DUBAI SHOPPING EXPERIENCE
itinerary.text: After breakfast, join a Half Day Dubai City Tour of Dubai's iconic landmarks. Start with a photo stop at the Burj Al Arab, then soak up the Arabian-style atmosphere of Souk Madinat. Continue to Palm Jumeirah with a photo stop at Atlantis The Palm and enjoy the view along Dubai Marina Walk. At midday, continue to Dubai Mall, Dubai's iconic shopping destination. Enjoy a photo stop at the Burj Khalifa, then use your free time to shop and explore the mall's attractions. End the day with the Dubai Fountain Show, a spectacular fountain performance and one of Dubai's favourite experiences, before returning to the hotel at around 8 pm. Overnight in Dubai.

itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, join a Half Day Dubai Sightseeing Tour with an English-speaking guide. Start with a photo stop at Al Seef, a Dubai Creek waterfront that blends traditional and modern styles, then visit Al Bastakiya, a historic quarter that witnessed the growth of Dubai. itinerary.title: ABU DHABI CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, join a Full Day Abu Dhabi City Tour with an English-speaking guide. Start at the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, one of Abu Dhabi's most magnificent landmarks, known for its stunning Islamic architecture. Then enjoy photo stops at Emirates Palace and the Presidential Palace before continuing to Yas Island, Abu Dhabi's popular leisure and entertainment district. Enjoy free time for shopping at Yas Mall and a chance to visit the Ferrari merchandise store. If you want to try the Ferrari-themed rides, Ferrari World is available as an option with an extra ticket. At around 8 pm, return to Dubai and transfer to the hotel. Overnight in Dubai.

itinerary.title: MODERN DUBAI CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, join a Full Day Sightseeing Tour of Modern Dubai to see the city's iconic landmarks and modern side. Start with a photo stop at the Dubai Frame, an iconic structure with views of both old and new Dubai, then a photo stop at the Museum of the Future, a futuristic landmark with unique architecture. Continue to Jumeirah for photo stops at the Burj Al Arab and Jumeirah Beach. Then visit Palm Jumeirah, the palm-shaped artificial island that is one of Dubai's icons, and pass Atlantis The Palm. Continue to Dubai Mall, one of the largest and most popular shopping centres in Dubai. Enjoy free time to shop and explore the mall's entertainment. You can also stop for photos at the Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building, with the option of going up to the observation deck with an extra ticket. In the evening, enjoy the spectacular Dubai Fountain Show before returning to the hotel at around 8 pm. Overnight in Dubai.

itinerary.title: FUKUOKA AIRPORT – FUKUOKA
itinerary.text: Welcome to Fukuoka, Japan! On arrival at Fukuoka Airport, you will be met and start your trip at Kamado Shrine, known for its leafy grounds and calming natural scenery. Then visit Dazaifu Tenmangu, a famous Shinto shrine dedicated to Sugawara no Michizane and one of Fukuoka's most popular sights. Afterwards, enjoy shopping around Hakata Station, with a wide range of shops, malls and Japanese souvenirs. After the tour, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.

itinerary.title: FUKUOKA – NAGASAKI
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Glover Garden, a historic garden with Western-style Meiji-era houses and beautiful views over Nagasaki. Then visit Nagasaki Peace Park and the Nagasaki Atomic Bomb Museum, which remember the 1945 atomic bombing and stand as a symbol of world peace. Continue to Nagasaki Shinchi Chinatown, known for its local food and lively streets. After sightseeing, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and have dinner at the hotel.

itinerary.title: NAGASAKI – KUMAMOTO
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, continue to Kumamoto by ferry (about 60 minutes). On arrival, visit Kumamoto Castle, one of Japan's most famous castles, rich in history and grand in design. Then visit the Luffy statue, a statue of the One Piece anime character and one of Kumamoto's attractions. Continue to Aso to visit Kusasenri, a wide grassland with beautiful scenery and stunning mountain views. After the tour, you will be taken to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: ASO – HITA – FUKUOKA
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, visit Mamedamachi in Hita, an old town known for traditional Japanese buildings, a classic atmosphere and shops selling local souvenirs. Then continue to Tosu Premium Outlets, a shopping centre with a wide choice of local and international brands. Continue to Fukuoka for shopping at LaLaport Fukuoka, a modern mall famous for its giant Gundam statue. After shopping and dinner, you will be taken back to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: FUKUOKA – FUKUOKA AIRPORT
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, check out and transfer to Fukuoka Airport for your flight home. This ends your trip in Japan. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. See you on your next journey.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL PENANG & NIGHT TOUR
itinerary.text: On arrival at Penang Airport, you will be met and taken to the hotel to check in and rest for a while. In the evening, enjoy a Penang Night Tour. Start at Gurney Drive Hawker Centre, a must-visit food paradise. Try Penang favourites such as char kway teow, Penang laksa, satay and Hokkien mee at affordable prices. Then visit Batu Ferringhi Night Market, a popular night market along the Batu Ferringhi strip. Hunt for souvenirs, clothes, bags, accessories and Penang specialities while enjoying the lively evening atmosphere. Afterwards, return to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: PENANG HALF DAY TOUR
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Kek Lok Si Temple, one of the largest and most famous Buddhist temples in Malaysia. Here you can see the seven-tier Pagoda of 10,000 Buddhas and the bronze statue of the goddess, the main attractions of the temple complex. Then continue to Penang Hill and ride the funicular train up the hill. At the top, enjoy a panoramic view of George Town and the city of Penang. Afterwards, return to the hotel to rest and enjoy free time.

itinerary.title: WELCOME TO AUCKLAND
itinerary.text: On arrival at Auckland International Airport, you will be met and taken to the hotel on a seat-in-coach (SIC) shared transfer. After check-in, rest and freshen up before your first New Zealand adventure. Then get to know Auckland, an appealing mix of modern city life and coastal nature. Enjoy sightseeing past iconic districts, the busy waterfront, lively city streets and viewpoints that show Auckland's character and culture. Continue to the Sky Tower, a famous landmark and the tallest structure in New Zealand. From the top, enjoy a stunning 360° view of Auckland, with the city skyline, the sparkling harbour and the surrounding landscape. Travel to the Sky Tower and back to the hotel is on your own (self transfer), giving you the freedom to enjoy Auckland at a relaxed pace.

itinerary.title: AUCKLAND – ROTORUA
itinerary.text: This morning, leave Auckland for Rotorua by Gray Line / GreatSights coach. Pass through the Waikato countryside, famous for its rolling green hills and beautiful scenery. The journey includes the Waitomo Glowworm Caves, one of New Zealand's most unique natural attractions. Glide through the underground cave by boat and enjoy the magical sight of thousands of glowworms lighting up the ceiling like a starry sky, an amazing and unforgettable experience. Then continue to the Hobbiton Movie Set, the iconic filming location of The Lord of the Rings and The Hobbit. Set in lush green countryside, explore the quirky hobbit holes, pretty pathways and the famous Green Dragon Inn. It is a special experience, especially for film lovers and Middle-earth fans. After Hobbiton, continue to Rotorua, famous for its geothermal wonders and rich Māori culture. A day full of natural beauty, magical experiences and movie magic that will make your New Zealand trip even more memorable. Inclusions: Waitomo Glowworm Caves entry, Hobbiton Movie Set Tour, Gray Line / GreatSights coach transfer.

itinerary.title: ROTORUA: AGRODOME & TE PO EVENING EXPERIENCE
itinerary.text: This morning, experience New Zealand country life at the Agrodome, one of Rotorua's best-known farm attractions. Enjoy an interactive, entertaining show and get to know New Zealand farm life up close. Watch live sheep shearing, meet the farm animals and learn about the farming traditions that are an important part of New Zealand life. In the evening, enjoy an equally special cultural experience at Te Pō Māori Cultural Experience. Discover Māori heritage through traditional performances, songs, dances, ancestral stories and traditions passed down through generations. The warm evening atmosphere and captivating performances offer an authentic way to understand the rich culture of Aotearoa, the Māori name for New Zealand. Today is a perfect blend of country life and Māori culture, showing you another unique and authentic side of New Zealand. Inclusions: Agrodome Farm Experience, Te Pō evening cultural experience, accommodation in Rotorua.

itinerary.title: ROTORUA – QUEENSTOWN by Domestic Flight
itinerary.text: This morning, leave Rotorua and travel on to Queenstown, known as the Adventure Capital of New Zealand. Set on the beautiful shores of Lake Wakatipu and surrounded by the majestic Southern Alps, the journey takes you from Rotorua's geothermal charm to spectacular mountain scenery. On arrival in Queenstown, you will be taken to the hotel by seat-in-coach (SIC) transfer. After check-in, you have free time to rest or start exploring this lovely town at your own pace. Stroll along the Lake Wakatipu waterfront, admire the mountain views or breathe in the fresh alpine air. You can also browse local boutiques, relax in a café or simply enjoy the lively, charming town. Today is the perfect transition from Rotorua's geothermal wonders to Queenstown's alpine beauty, combining amazing scenery with time to relax in one of New Zealand's prettiest towns.
itinerary.hotel: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Queenstown / or similar

itinerary.title: SIC MILFORD SOUND CRUISE
itinerary.text: Today, enjoy one of New Zealand's most spectacular journeys to Milford Sound, famous for its breathtaking fjord scenery. From Queenstown, the seat-in-coach (SIC) trip takes you through the dramatic landscapes of Fiordland National Park, with mountains, towering cliffs, green rainforest and waterfalls along the way. At Milford Sound, enjoy a cruise on the calm, clear waters of the fjord. Admire the towering Mitre Peak, dramatic cliffs and spectacular waterfalls that drop straight from the mountainsides. If you are lucky, you may see wildlife such as seals and penguins in their natural habitat. Take in the peace and beauty of Milford Sound and capture the amazing scenery. As part of Fiordland National Park and a World Heritage Area, this will be one of the most memorable nature experiences of your New Zealand adventure. After Milford Sound, return to Queenstown in the late afternoon or evening, taking home memories of mountains, majestic fjords and unforgettable nature. Inclusions: SIC Milford Sound Cruise, scenic coach transfer from Queenstown to Milford Sound (SIC basis).
itinerary.hotel: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Queenstown / or similar

itinerary.title: QUEENSTOWN HIGHLIGHTS & SKYLINE 3 LUGE RIDES
itinerary.text: This morning, explore Queenstown on the Queenstown Highlights Tour. Visit the town's best spots while admiring Lake Wakatipu, the majestic mountains and the charming lakeside atmosphere. Don't forget to take photos at the scenic viewpoints against Queenstown's spectacular backdrop. Then continue to Skyline Queenstown for scenery and fun combined. Ride the gondola to the top and enjoy stunning views of Lake Wakatipu and the alpine ranges. At the top, get ready for 3 luge rides, a fun downhill ride suitable for all ages. Feel the thrill of racing down the track while enjoying amazing views of Queenstown. It is also a perfect chance for great photos with the mountains and lake behind you. Today combines Queenstown's beauty, spectacular alpine scenery and adventure, making your stay complete and memorable. Inclusions: SIC Queenstown Highlights Tour, Skyline Queenstown gondola ride, 3 luge rides.
itinerary.hotel: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Queenstown / or similar

itinerary.title: QUEENSTOWN – DEPARTURE
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy free time until check-out. You will then be taken to Queenstown Airport for your flight back to Jakarta. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. We hope you take home wonderful, unforgettable memories. See you on your next journey.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL MANILA
itinerary.text: On arrival at Manila International Airport, our representative will meet you, help with arrival formalities and take you to the hotel. Check in and take time to rest or enjoy the area around the hotel. The rest of the day is free. Lunch and dinner are on your own account.

itinerary.title: MANILA CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, explore Manila's historic and iconic sights on a Manila City Tour. Start at Intramuros, the historic "Walled City" that witnessed Manila's Spanish colonial era. Then visit Fort Santiago, a historic landmark closely linked to Dr José Rizal, the national hero of the Philippines. Continue to San Agustin Church, a historic Baroque church that is part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and Manila Cathedral, one of the best-known Catholic churches in the Philippines, rebuilt several times over its history. Next, head to Rizal Park (Luneta Park), a historic park, national landmark and home of the Rizal Monument. Continue to the National Museum Complex to learn about the history, culture, art and natural wealth of the Philippines. Museum visits depend on opening hours and the tour schedule. At midday, enjoy lunch at a local restaurant before continuing to Bonifacio Global City (BGC). In contrast to the historic morning, BGC shows Manila's modern side, with contemporary buildings, green spaces, food and entertainment hubs and many interesting spots. Enjoy some time at Bonifacio High Street, a pedestrian area full of restaurants, cafés, shops, open spaces and art installations. In the afternoon, visit the Manila American Cemetery and Memorial, which honours American military personnel who died in World War II. Here you can see the chapel, the memorial walls and rows of white marble headstones in beautifully kept grounds. In the evening, enjoy dinner at a local restaurant before returning to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: MANILA – CLARK CITY TOUR – MANILA
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, travel to Clark, a former United States military base that is now a tourism, business, entertainment and leisure hub in Central Luzon. In Clark, explore the Clark Freeport Zone, which blends its past with modern development, surrounded by green areas and leisure facilities. Continue to the Clark Parade Grounds, a historic former part of the base now used for sport, community activities and cultural events. Then visit the Clark Museum and 4D Theater to learn about Clark's history and heritage, from local cultural roots through the Spanish and American colonial periods to the Clark of today. The immersive 4D show brings Clark's history to life. Continue to Nayong Pilipino Clark, a cultural park with replicas of Philippine landmarks, traditional houses and other elements of Filipino culture. Don't miss the Salakot Arch, a Clark landmark inspired by the salakot, the traditional Filipino hat that symbolises local culture and hospitality, and a great photo spot. At midday, enjoy lunch at a local restaurant. After lunch, enjoy more of Clark before returning to Manila. In Manila, enjoy dinner at a local restaurant before returning to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: MANILA – DEPARTURE
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, check out and get ready to end your trip in the Philippines. You will be taken to Manila International Airport for your flight home. We hope exploring Manila and Clark has been a memorable experience with many good stories to remember. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. See you on your next journey.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL SINGAPORE – MANDAI NIGHT SAFARI
itinerary.text: On arrival in Singapore, you will be picked up by a private car and driver and taken to the hotel to check in. Standard hotel check-in time is 3 pm. After some rest, you will be picked up in the evening for the Night Safari, one of Singapore's most popular attractions. Enjoy a safari after dark and see animals in their natural habitats. Afterwards, you will be taken back to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: SINGAPORE HALF DAY CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, you will be picked up at 9.45 am for a Half Day City Tour of Singapore's icons and neighbourhoods. Start with a photo stop at Merlion Park with the city's iconic Merlion statue, then pass the Esplanade and visit Masjid Sultan, a historic landmark in Kampong Glam. Next, stroll along Arab Street, known for its distinctive atmosphere and its shops and cafés. Enjoy some shopping time at Bugis or Mustafa before passing Orchard Road, Singapore's famous shopping street. The city tour ends with a photo stop at Universal Studios Singapore and a drive past the iconic Marina Bay Sands. After the city tour, you will be taken back to the hotel at around 1.15 pm for free time.

itinerary.title: SENTOSA ISLAND
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, you will be picked up at 9 am for Sentosa Island. Travel to the island on the Sentosa Cable Car and enjoy the view from above. On Sentosa, visit Madame Tussauds Singapore to see wax figures of world-famous people. Then enjoy Wings of Time, a spectacular beachside show combining light, water, music and visual effects. After the activities, you will be taken back to the hotel at around 8.30 pm.

itinerary.title: SINGAPORE – DEPARTURE
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy free time until check-out at 12 noon. After check-out, a private car and driver will take you to Singapore Changi Airport for your onward flight. We hope your stay in Singapore has been enjoyable and memorable. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. See you on your next journey.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL MADRID
itinerary.text: On arrival in Spain, you will be met and enjoy a private transfer from the airport to your hotel in Madrid. Check in and enjoy free time to rest after the long journey. Overnight in Madrid.

itinerary.title: MADRID – ALICANTE by Train
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, start the day with a private half-day city tour of Madrid with an English-speaking guide/assistant. Pass the city's iconic landmarks, including the Royal Palace, the Prado Museum, Puerta del Sol and Plaza Mayor. Enjoy the blend of history, culture and Spanish architecture. After lunch on your own, you will be taken to Madrid Chamartín station for the high-speed train to Alicante. The train is scheduled to leave at 3 pm and arrive at about 5.17 pm. In Alicante, you will be met and taken to the hotel to check in. Relax and rest in this coastal city known for its Mediterranean atmosphere. Overnight in Alicante.

itinerary.title: ALICANTE
itinerary.text: After breakfast, get ready for a special experience at the Ferrero Tennis Academy, one of Spain's leading tennis academies, founded by former world number one Juan Carlos Ferrero. The academy is also a training base of Carlos Alcaraz, one of today's best tennis players. The morning is filled with tennis and padel training: a padel session from 9.30 to 11.30 am, a break, then a match with a coach from 12 to 1.30 pm. Feel the training atmosphere of a world-class academy first-hand. After the session, you will be taken back to your hotel in Alicante to rest. In the afternoon, enjoy a city tour of Alicante. Walk along the Passeig Esplanada d'Espanya, the iconic promenade with its distinctive mosaic pattern and one of the city's most popular spots. Then visit the Castell de Santa Bàrbara, a historic fortress with beautiful views over the city and the Alicante coast. After the tour, return to the hotel for free time. Overnight in Alicante.

itinerary.title: ALICANTE
itinerary.text: After breakfast, return to the Ferrero Tennis Academy for a morning training session at one of Spain's leading tennis academies, founded by former world number one Juan Carlos Ferrero and known as a training base of Carlos Alcaraz. The session starts with padel from 9.30 to 11.30 am, followed by a break until 12 noon. Then test your skills in a match with a coach from 12 to 1.30 pm. Enjoy training and playing in the atmosphere of an international-standard academy. After the session, a private transfer takes you back to your hotel in Alicante. The afternoon is free to relax, enjoy Alicante, go shopping or explore the city on your own. Overnight in Alicante.

itinerary.title: ALICANTE – MADRID by Train
itinerary.text: After breakfast, check out and take a private transfer to the station for the high-speed train back to Madrid. Enjoy a comfortable ride and the scenery along the way. In Madrid, your guide will meet you; lunch is on your own. In the afternoon, enjoy a Madrid city tour including a must for football fans, the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium. Explore Real Madrid's famous home ground and get a close look at the atmosphere and history of one of the most famous football clubs in the world. After the tour, go to the hotel to check in and rest. Overnight in Madrid.

itinerary.title: MADRID
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy your last moments in Madrid until check-out. A private transfer will then take you to the airport for your flight home, taking with you great memories of tennis, padel and football in Spain. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. See you on your next journey.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL TAIWAN
itinerary.text: On arrival at Taoyuan International Airport, our representative will meet you and take you to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: TAIPEI – SHIFEN – YILAN
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, head into Taiwan's mountains for a mix of nature, old-town charm and local culture. Visit Jiufen Old Street, a historic area with classic alleys, souvenir shops and delicious Taiwanese snacks. Continue to Shifen, where you can release a sky lantern with your group (1 lantern for 4–5 people). Then enjoy Shifen Waterfall, one of Taiwan's best-known waterfalls with stunning scenery. Continue to Yilan to visit Luodong Forestry Culture Park, a former forestry site that is now a green, historic visitor attraction. In the evening, relax and explore Luodong Night Market, with local snacks, Taiwanese food and shopping in a lively night-market atmosphere. Afterwards, return to the hotel to rest.
itinerary.hotel: Yilan Haoke B&B / Lakeshore Yilan / or similar

itinerary.title: YILAN
itinerary.text: Today, enjoy Yilan's mix of countryside charm, nature, food and local culture. Start at Sanxing Green Onion Farm, where you can tour the farm, try harvesting and washing green onions yourself and make your own green onion pancake. It is a fun way to get to know Taiwan's local produce. Then visit Qingshui Geothermal Park, a leafy natural area where you can cook eggs or corn in the hot springs (optional). Continue to the Sloth Restaurant for a culinary experience, then to Tangweigou Hot Spring Street, Yilan's famous hot spring area. To end the day, enjoy the onsen hot spring facilities at the hotel to relax after a busy day. Swimwear and a swim cap must be worn in the hot spring baths. Afterwards, return to your room to rest.

itinerary.title: YILAN – TAIPEI CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: After breakfast, return to Taipei, Taiwan's capital, an appealing mix of history, culture and modern life. On the way, visit the Aboriginal Products Center to see products made by local communities, followed by the Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall, a historic landmark and one of Taipei's main icons, with grand architecture and spacious gardens. Then learn about Taiwanese tea culture at a tea experience centre and visit Rongjin Lifestyle Park, a creative district of classic-style buildings with cafés, unique shops and photo spots. Continue to a handicraft centre to see Taiwanese crafts that make great souvenirs. In the late afternoon, enjoy Ximending, a popular district known as Taipei's centre for youth trends, fashion, food and entertainment. Use your time to shop or try local snacks before returning to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: TAIWAN DEPARTURE
itinerary.text: After breakfast, free time until your pick-up for the transfer to Taoyuan International Airport. Enjoy your last moments in Taiwan before your flight home. Thank you for joining us; we hope exploring Taiwan has given you happy memories. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. See you on your next journey.

itinerary.title: TAIPEI – HSINCHU – TAICHUNG
itinerary.text: After breakfast, continue to Hsinchu and Taichung for a mix of culture, flower gardens and local Taiwanese life. Visit Hukou Cultural Creative Park, an area with a cultural feel and classic architecture to explore. Then enjoy the colourful blooms at Chungshe Tourist Flower Market, a pretty spot for holiday photos. Continue to the Houfeng Bikeway, a recreational trail with refreshing natural scenery. If you would like to cycle, bikes can be rented at your own cost. In the evening, visit a Taichung night market to feel the buzz of a Taiwanese night market, hunt for local food and enjoy the lively city. Afterwards, transfer to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: TAICHUNG – NANTOU – QINGJING
itinerary.text: Today, continue into the Nantou mountains, with cool air and stunning scenery. The first stop is Rainbow Village, a unique place covered in colourful murals and an iconic photo spot. Then visit Qingjing Farm, a highland farm famous for its green pastures and beautiful mountain views. Continue to the Qingjing Skywalk, a walkway that lets you see the mountain scenery from a different angle. Enjoy the peace, the fresh mountain air and Nantou's natural beauty before transferring to the hotel to rest.
itinerary.hotel: Jun Yue Resort Cottage / or similar

itinerary.title: NANTOU – MIAOLI – TAIPEI
itinerary.text: After breakfast, return to Taipei, visiting several interesting places along the way. Stop at the Aboriginal Products Center to discover products made by local Taiwanese communities. Then pick seasonal fruit yourself on a fruit-picking experience, a fun way to enjoy a Taiwanese farm. Continue to the Miaoli Railway Museum to learn about the history and world of railways. In Taipei, visit Ximending, a popular district known for shopping, food, entertainment and youth trends. Enjoy time to shop, try local snacks and feel the modern, lively atmosphere of Taipei. Afterwards, transfer to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: TAIPEI CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: Today, explore places that combine culture, traditional crafts and classic Taiwanese experiences. Visit a handicraft centre to see a range of local crafts, then continue to Jiufen Old Street, a historic area famous for its traditional alleys, classic buildings, souvenir shops and delicious local food. Then visit a pearl cultivation centre to learn about pearl farming, and the National Gift Tea Experience Center to discover Taiwanese tea. Before the day ends, you can also shop for local souvenirs to take home for family and friends. Afterwards, you will be taken back to the hotel.

itinerary.title: TAIWAN DEPARTURE
itinerary.text: After breakfast, free time until your pick-up for the transfer to Taoyuan International Airport. Enjoy your last moments in Taiwan before your flight home. itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN BANGKOK
itinerary.text: On arrival in Bangkok, you will be met and taken to the hotel to check in. Overnight in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: BANGKOK
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, start the day at Chao Phraya Sky Park, a great spot for views of the Chao Phraya River and the Bangkok skyline. Continue to ICONSIAM, Bangkok's famous lifestyle and shopping destination that blends modern style with Thai culture. Then visit the Honey Bee and Erawadee herbal shops to discover Thai products, herbal goods and honey that make good souvenirs. Next, visit the Gems Gallery to learn about gemstones and Thai jewellery. In the late afternoon, enjoy free time in Bangkok's Chinatown, a colourful district of shops, local food and street life, and one of the city's most iconic areas. In the evening, continue to Jodd Fairs Night Market, one of Bangkok's most popular night spots. Enjoy free time for food, shopping and Bangkok's lively nightlife. After the day's programme, return to the hotel. Overnight in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: BANGKOK
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then start the day at Pratunam and Platinum Fashion Mall, one of Bangkok's most popular shopping areas, with a wide choice of fashion, clothing, accessories and souvenirs at attractive prices. Continue to MBK Center, Bangkok's iconic mall selling everything from fashion and electronics to souvenirs and daily needs. Then visit TOFU Skincare to discover and shop for Thai skincare and beauty products. Next, head to the Gentlewoman flagship store at Siam Square, a fashion and lifestyle area popular with Bangkok's young crowd. Continue to EmQuartier, a premium mall with international brands, restaurants and lifestyle experiences in a modern, elegant setting. In the evening, visit Samyan Mitrtown, a modern lifestyle centre known for its varied food choices, with areas open 24 hours. To end the day, head to Asiatique The Riverfront night market. Enjoy Bangkok's evening atmosphere on the Chao Phraya River with food, souvenir shopping and entertainment. After the day's activities, return to the hotel. Overnight in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: BANGKOK – DEPARTURE

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN BANGKOK
itinerary.text: On arrival at Bangkok airport, you will be met and taken to the hotel to check in. Free time and overnight in Bangkok.

itinerary.title: BANGKOK – PATTAYA
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then depart for Pattaya. On the way, visit a honey bee farm to discover honey products and enjoy the farm atmosphere. Then enjoy a taste of winter at Frost Magical Ice of Siam, before continuing to Dinosaurs Park – Valley of Dinosaurs to see dinosaur replicas in a unique, educational setting. Continue to Nong Nooch Village, one of Pattaya's best-known attractions. Here you can watch a Thai cultural show and an elephant show, followed by a buffet lunch. After lunch, visit Laser Buddha Hill (Khao Chi Chan) to see the iconic Buddha image laser-carved into a limestone cliff. Then stop at the Erawadee herb shop to discover Thai herbal products. In the late afternoon, enjoy Pattaya Beach around the Hard Rock area before dinner at a local restaurant. For those who want an evening show, an optional cabaret show is available at extra cost. After the day's activities, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.

itinerary.title: PATTAYA – BANGKOK & SHOPPING
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then check out and travel back to Bangkok. On the way, visit the Gems Gallery museum to learn about jewellery and gemstones, including a train ride inside the museum. Continue to a dried-food local product centre to discover Thai dried snacks that make good souvenirs. Then head to Platinum Fashion Mall, one of Bangkok's popular fashion malls. You will have time to shop and have lunch with a THB 150 lunch coupon per person. After lunch, continue to Wat Arun – Temple of Dawn, one of Bangkok's iconic landmarks on the Chao Phraya River. Admire the temple architecture, one of Thailand's great cultural attractions. Next, cruise along the Chao Phraya River by tourist boat to ICONSIAM and the SookSiam floating market. Enjoy the river, the Bangkok skyline and a range of Thai food and products in one modern, unique complex. In the evening, enjoy free time and dinner at Asiatique The Riverfront night market, with Bangkok's night atmosphere, food, shopping and entertainment by the river. After the day's activities, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.

itinerary.title: JAKARTA – KUALA LUMPUR – JOHOR BAHRU
itinerary.text: Today we meet at Soekarno-Hatta Airport Terminal 3 for our Malaysia Airlines flight to Kuala Lumpur. In Kuala Lumpur, our friendly guide will meet us and take us straight to Malacca. In Malacca, we visit the Red Square (Stadthuys), an iconic complex of red-brick Dutch colonial buildings. Here we can also take photos at Christ Church (photo stop), the oldest Protestant church in Malaysia, built in 1753. Then we visit A Famosa (photo stop), a Portuguese fortress and one of the oldest in Asia. We then take photos on Jonker Street, the Chinatown area famous for its food, before going on to Johor Bahru to check in at the hotel and rest.

itinerary.title: JOHOR BAHRU – SINGAPORE – KUALA LUMPUR
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. We travel to Singapore and visit Merlion Park (photo stop), home of the famous lion-headed, fish-bodied Merlion statue. We pass the Esplanade and the Singapore Flyer, then visit Gardens by the Bay (photo stop), a 101-hectare urban nature park, and Orchard Road (photo stop), the main boulevard famous for shopping, restaurants and modern city life. We stop at a souvenir shop before returning to Kuala Lumpur. Check in at the hotel and rest.

itinerary.title: KUALA LUMPUR – HAT YAI
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. We visit Istana Negara (photo stop), the official residence of the King of Malaysia. Then we continue to the Malaysia–Thailand border to visit Hat Yai. Check in at the hotel and rest.

itinerary.title: HAT YAI
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. We travel to Songkhla to visit Samila Beach, famous for its Mermaid statue (photo stop) and beautiful white sand. Then we visit the Reclining Buddha (photo stop), one of the largest statues in Thailand. We continue with shopping at Kaysorn, Nora Plaza and a honey house. We also visit the floating market (weekends only), famous for its food. After lunch, we return to the hotel for free time. You can try a tuk-tuk ride (optional) or sample all kinds of food at Lee Garden Plaza.

itinerary.title: HAT YAI – PENANG – KUALA LUMPUR
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. We travel back to Kuala Lumpur on the North–South Expressway, first visiting Penang via the Penang Bridge. Here we visit Fort Cornwallis (photo stop), the largest and oldest fort in Malaysia. Check in at the hotel and rest.

itinerary.title: KUALA LUMPUR – GENTING
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. We shop at Chocolate Kingdom and visit the Petronas Twin Towers (photo stop), Kuala Lumpur's iconic landmark. Then we visit Batu Caves, a series of limestone hills housing a Hindu temple complex. Next we visit Genting Highlands Premium Outlets for shopping and Genting Highlands (including the cable car), where we can enjoy the hilltop views or explore SkyAvenue Genting. Return to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: KUALA LUMPUR – DEPARTURE
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then a visit to Mitsui Outlet Park, famous for branded goods at low prices, before going to the airport for the flight back to Jakarta. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. We hope you take home wonderful, unforgettable memories. See you on your next journey. *The order of the itinerary/cities may change depending on needs or conditions on the ground, as decided by the organiser. MINIMUM DEPARTURE: 30 ADULT PARTICIPANTS

itinerary.title: JAKARTA – DOHA – TASHKENT
itinerary.text: Today participants meet at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport Terminal 3 for the flight to Tashkent via Doha. On arrival in Tashkent, you will be taken to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: TASHKENT (UZBEKISTAN) – SAMARKAND
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today visit the Hazrati Imam Complex and Chorsu Bazaar, the cultural heart of Uzbekistan since the Silk Road era, then the White Mosque. In the afternoon, you will be taken to the station for the high-speed train to Samarkand. On arrival in Samarkand, transfer to the hotel for the night.

itinerary.title: SAMARKAND – TASHKENT
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Registan Square, see the Bibi-Khanym Mosque from outside, and visit the Memorial Complex of Imam Al-Bukhari and the Shah-i-Zinda architectural complex, part of the Samarkand UNESCO World Heritage Site. In the afternoon, take the high-speed train to Tashkent, then check in at the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: TASHKENT – BISHKEK (KYRGYZSTAN)
itinerary.text: After breakfast and check-out, you will be taken to the airport for the flight to Bishkek. On arrival in Bishkek, transfer to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: BISHKEK – ALA ARCHA NATIONAL PARK – BISHKEK
itinerary.text: After breakfast, head to Ala Archa National Park to enjoy Kyrgyzstan's mountain scenery, then return to Bishkek to visit the Central Mosque and the TSUM department store / bazaar.

itinerary.title: BISHKEK – ALMATY (KAZAKHSTAN)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, travel overland to Almaty, crossing the Kyrgyzstan–Kazakhstan border. The drive takes about 3–4 hours. In Almaty, visit the Almaty Central Mosque and the Green Bazaar (local market).

itinerary.title: ALMATY – KOLSAI LAKE – CHARYN CANYON – ALMATY
itinerary.text: After breakfast, continue to Kolsai Lake, where you can relax at a local café, walk around the lake or join an optional tour such as a boat ride (depending on seasonal operation and weather). Continue to Charyn Canyon, one of Kazakhstan's most stunning natural landmarks. Afterwards, return to Almaty and transfer to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: ALMATY – SHYMBULAK AREA – AIRPORT
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Shymbulak, Kazakhstan's famous resort area, where you can join an optional cable car ride for mountain views. Optional: return cable car at Shymbulak (cable car not included). Afterwards, you will be taken to the airport for the flight to Jakarta via Doha.

itinerary.title: DEPARTURE TO JAKARTA
itinerary.text: Today, fly back to Jakarta; the trip ends on arrival in Jakarta. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. We hope you take home wonderful, unforgettable memories. See you on your next journey. MINIMUM DEPARTURE: 25 ADULT PARTICIPANTS

itinerary.title: JAKARTA – SYDNEY
itinerary.text: Today participants meet at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport Terminal 3 for the departure to Sydney, Australia.

itinerary.title: SYDNEY CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: On arrival in Sydney, we visit the city's icon, the Sydney Opera House (photo stop), a performing arts venue with famous 20th-century architecture. Then we explore The Rocks and Circular Quay, the harbourside area below the Sydney Harbour Bridge known for fashion shopping and food. Next is Mrs Macquarie's Chair (photo stop), a bench carved from rock by convicts, commissioned by an early governor of the colony for his wife. On the way to Chinatown and the CBD, we visit Darling Harbour, a natural inlet with beautiful water views. Check in at the hotel and rest. [Note: the places visited may be adjusted to arrival time, flight schedules and local operating conditions.] Overnight at a 3* hotel / or similar.

itinerary.title: SYDNEY – BLUE MOUNTAINS – SYDNEY
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then we head to the Blue Mountains, an Australian national park famous for its beautiful scenery. We visit Echo Point Lookout and the Three Sisters (photo stop), the best spot to enjoy the Blue Mountains panorama and its iconic rock formation. Then we enjoy the attractions at Scenic World with the Ultimate Discovery Pass, riding the Railway, Skyway and Cableway. In the afternoon, we return to Sydney for shopping at DFO Homebush, a popular outlet centre with many well-known brands. Return to the hotel to rest.
itinerary.hotel: Overnight at a 3* hotel / or similar

itinerary.title: SYDNEY – GOLD COAST
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, check out and go to the airport for the flight to the Gold Coast. On the Gold Coast, we visit HOTA (Home of the Arts), the city's arts and culture hub with contemporary galleries, music performances and beautiful views, then Burleigh Beach (photo stop). We see Hedges and Albatross Avenues, known for luxury beachfront homes and an exclusive coastal lifestyle. Then on to Narrowneck (photo stop), an iconic spot on the Gold Coast known for its artificial reef and as one of the area's best surf spots, and past the Southport Yacht Club. Then we visit Marina Mirage wharf and Pacific Fair Shopping Centre for shopping. Check in at the hotel and rest. [Note: the places visited may be adjusted to arrival time, flight schedules and local operating conditions.] Overnight at a 3* hotel / or similar.

itinerary.title: GOLD COAST – MOVIE WORLD – GOLD COAST
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today we explore Movie World (entry included), a film-themed park featuring Warner Bros. characters and movies. It combines thrilling rides, live shows and interactive experiences that make you feel part of the movies. Return to the hotel to rest. Overnight at a 3* hotel / or similar.

itinerary.title: GOLD COAST – MELBOURNE
itinerary.text: Breakfast box, check out and go to the airport for the flight to Melbourne. In Melbourne, we take a city tour of Melbourne's icons, such as Parliament House (photo stop), St Patrick's Cathedral (photo stop), Captain Cook's Cottage (photo stop), the MCG, Rod Laver Arena, the Royal Botanic Gardens, the Shrine of Remembrance (photo stop), the National Gallery of Victoria, the Arts Centre, Federation Square and Flinders Street Station, which together show Melbourne's history, culture, sport and architecture. [Note: the places visited may be adjusted to arrival time, flight schedules and local operating conditions.] Overnight at a 3* hotel / or similar. Breakfast at the hotel; today we visit Ballarat Wildlife Park to meet Australian animals such as kangaroos, koalas and wombats. We also visit Sovereign Hill, famous for its gold-rush-era town life and Victorian-era costumes. Return to Melbourne to rest. Overnight at a 3* hotel / or similar.

itinerary.title: MELBOURNE FREE DAY
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, the day is free for you to explore Melbourne. Return to the hotel to rest. (No guide, no transport, no tour leader.) Overnight at a 3* hotel / or similar.

itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then at the right time you will be taken to the airport for the flight back to Jakarta; the trip ends on arrival in Jakarta. itinerary.title: JAKARTA – HANOI – BEIJING
itinerary.text: ✈ VN634 CGKHAN 0130 0620 // VN512 HANPEK 1005 1445. Then visit Shichahai, a historic lake district lined with traditional hutong buildings and one of Beijing's tourist icons. Afterwards, go to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: BEIJING

itinerary.title: BEIJING

itinerary.title: BEIJING

itinerary.text: Today participants meet at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport Terminal 3 for the Spring Airlines flight to Guangzhou. Overnight on the plane.

itinerary.title: GUANGZHOU – SHENZHEN (breakfast box, lunch)
itinerary.text: On arrival in Guangzhou at 3.35 am, you will meet your guide, with pick-up at around 5 am. Start at Yuexiu Park, a famous city park and one of Guangzhou's icons. Then visit Flower City Square and Haixinsha Island, and see the Haixin Bridge and the Pearl River from outside. Stop for photos with the Canton Tower behind you, then stroll along Beijing Road Pedestrian Street. At around 4 pm, continue to Shenzhen to check in at the hotel and rest.

itinerary.title: SHENZHEN
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Lianhuashan Park, one of Shenzhen's popular city parks. Then stop for photos outside the Ping An Finance Center, one of the city's tallest skyscrapers. Afterwards, visit the mandatory jewellery and traditional Chinese medicine shops, then enjoy free time for shopping on Dongmen Pedestrian Street.
itinerary.hotel: Shenzhen Bao'an Venus Hotel / or similar

itinerary.title: SHENZHEN – ZHUHAI
itinerary.text: After breakfast, travel to Zhuhai by bus. In Zhuhai, visit the Zhuhai Opera House (Sun and Moon Shell), an iconic shell-shaped building. Then visit the Fisher Girl statue, one of Zhuhai's best-known landmarks. Continue to the mandatory silk and bamboo charcoal shops, then go to the hotel to check in and rest.

itinerary.title: ZHUHAI – QINGYUAN – GUANGZHOU

In Guangzhou, visit Yongqingfang and Xinlizhiwan and see the Bruce Lee ancestral home. Then go to the hotel to check in and rest.

itinerary.title: HARBIN – VOLGA MANOR

itinerary.title: HARBIN

itinerary.title: JAKARTA – KUNMING
itinerary.text: Today participants meet at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport Terminal 3 for the departure to Kunming, known as the "City of Eternal Spring" for its mild climate all year round. The city is not only naturally beautiful but also rich in culture, history and ethnic diversity.

itinerary.title: KUNMING – JIANSHUI
itinerary.text: On arrival in Kunming, visit Fuhaiwan Wetland Park, with stunning scenery that combines water and flowers. On one side lie the clear, sparkling waters of Fuxian Lake; on the other, wide fields of flowers line the shore, creating a captivating, harmonious landscape. Continue to Shuanglong Bridge, an ancient stone bridge built in the Qing Dynasty and one of Jianshui's historic icons. Known for its elegant traditional design, the bridge has 17 arches spanning the meeting point of two rivers. Then continue to the Daban Well, an ancient well used by locals for hundreds of years and known as one of Jianshui's best springs, with clear, fresh, naturally sweet water.

itinerary.title: JIANSHUI
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Beishan Pottery Village, a cultural area built over 11 years using discarded Jianshui purple pottery and natural stone as its main materials. The whole area has a unique architecture that at first glance resembles a European castle, yet keeps Jianshui's own cultural character. Then continue to Jianshui Ancient Town, an old town that still keeps many historic Ming and Qing Dynasty buildings, including an ancient city gate, traditional houses, temples and cobbled streets. Jianshui is also known as a centre of culture and learning in Yunnan and is home to the second-largest Confucius temple in China. Then visit Zitao Street, a culture and food street celebrating Jianshui purple pottery, one of China's most famous ceramic crafts with over a thousand years of history. Along the street you will find pottery galleries, souvenir shops, cafés, restaurants and traditional-style buildings that blend local art and culture.

itinerary.title: JIANSHUI – MILE
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Dongfengyun Scenic Area, an art and culture destination that blends architecture, nature and creativity. Designed by the artist Luo Xu using Yunnan's red brick, its buildings have organic, curving forms often compared to anthills, caves or natural sculptures, creating an iconic artistic landscape. Then explore Mile Water Town, a Jiangnan-style area of canals, stone bridges and traditional buildings. Its calm, romantic atmosphere makes it ideal for a relaxed stroll and a taste of a classic Chinese water town.

itinerary.title: MILE – KUNMING
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Taiping Lake Forest Park, an ecotourism area famous for colourful flower fields, wide green forests and refreshing nature. Then shop at an astaxanthin shop. Next, visit the Heishiqing Stone Forest in Xinglin Grand View Park, part of Yunnan's Stone Forest scenic area. Enjoy a special chance to explore unique karst formations in a calm, captivating natural setting, far from the bustle of the city. It is a perfect place to connect with nature, and it draws many domestic and international visitors every year.

itinerary.title: SHILIN – KUNMING
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit a herbal medicine shop. Then visit Jiaozi Snow Mountain (including cable car), north of Kunming, with a main peak of 4,223 metres above sea level. Snowy mountains are rare around Kunming, the "Spring City", but the stunning Jiaozi Snow Mountain is the exception. It is named after its shape, which resembles a sedan chair (jiaozi). In winter, Jiaozi Snow Mountain offers mountains blanketed in white snow, like a scene from a fairy tale, with snowy forests, ice-covered cliffs and a sea of clouds between the peaks. The cool mountain air and stunning winter landscape make it one of the best places in Yunnan to enjoy snow and take photos against spectacular scenery.

itinerary.title: KUNMING
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit a silk store. Then visit Grand View Park (Daguan Pavilion), with flower displays that change every month. From November to March is the best time to see the beautiful black-headed gulls from Siberia. Stroll along the lakeside, feed the gulls and enjoy close encounters with them. Continue to Kunming Old Street, a historic area that has seen the city grow over hundreds of years. Its old streets are lined with traditional Ming and Qing-style buildings combined with cafés, restaurants, souvenir shops and modern boutiques, a harmonious blend of classic culture and modern city life.

itinerary.title: KUNMING – JAKARTA
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Golden Temple Park (including battery car), a historic Taoist temple complex famous for its bronze-clad temple and leafy gardens, one of Kunming's important cultural sites. Then visit a jewellery shop. You will then be taken to the airport at the scheduled time for the flight back to Jakarta. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. itinerary.title: JAKARTA – CHONGQING
itinerary.text: Today we meet at Soekarno-Hatta Airport to start the journey to Chongqing, China's largest metropolis.

itinerary.title: CHONGQING
itinerary.text: On arrival in Chongqing, your guide will meet you and take you to see the Great Hall of the People from outside, a symbol of the people of Chongqing's determination to build a better future and of the hard work behind the city's achievements. Then stop for photos at Liziba, the light-rail station famous for trains running straight through an apartment building. The station has drawn worldwide attention since it opened because of its uniqueness; first-time visitors, whether on the train or watching from below, are amazed to see the train "disappear" into the building. Next, visit the Liberation Monument, listed among the "Ten new landmarks of Chengdu–Chongqing cultural tourism". Then stroll along the Liberation Monument Walking Street to taste Chongqing's local food. You will also visit Hongya Cave, once known as Hongya Gate, one of the gates of old Chongqing. Here you can see the traditional Bayu stilted architecture called "diaojiaolou".

itinerary.title: CHONGQING – YANGTZE RIVER CRUISE
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Ciqikou Ancient Town, known to visitors as "Little Chongqing". Surrounded by three mountains and crossed by one river and two streams, Ciqikou was a strategic transport hub and a famous trading port in ancient times. Today it is a favourite place for locals to relax. Then visit Danzishi Old Street. With its "Old Street · New Fun" concept, visitors can enjoy traditional Sichuan–Chongqing architecture and the charm of an ancient mountain town. As you stroll along the old street, browse interesting shops and taste a variety of delicious food. Then you will be taken to board the Three Gorges of the Yangtze River cruise.

itinerary.title: YANGTZE RIVER CRUISE (FENGDU CITY)
itinerary.text: After breakfast, stop to visit Fengdu Ghost City (including cable car), a cultural site famous for the legends of the afterlife in traditional Chinese belief. The complex is full of temples, statues and historic gates that depict life after death and moral values, making it one of Chongqing's most unique cultural and historical attractions.

itinerary.title: YANGTZE RIVER CRUISE (BAIDI CITY)
itinerary.text: Today is a free day on the cruise. After breakfast, you can go ashore and join the optional tours offered.

itinerary.title: YANGTZE RIVER CRUISE – YICHANG – WUHAN
itinerary.text: After breakfast, you can join the cruise's optional tour before check-out. After lunch, you will be taken to Jingzhou to visit the Jingzhou Ancient City Walls, one of the best-preserved ancient city walls in China, with more than 2,000 years of history. Built in the Three Kingdoms period and improved under the Ming and Qing dynasties, the walls are an important symbol of Jingzhou's heritage and offer views of an old town rich in culture and history. Then continue to Wuhan for dinner and hotel check-in.

itinerary.title: WUHAN
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the East Lake Scenic Area, one of the largest urban lakes in China. Stroll along the East Lake Greenway and enjoy the rippling blue water and willow trees along the shore. Then stop for photos outside the Yellow Crane Tower (including battery car). This ancient tower stands proudly on top of Snake Hill, with five storeys, upturned eaves like the wings of a yellow crane and a stunning golden roof, a classic sight by the river. Finally, stroll along Jianghan Road Pedestrian Street, an old street of more than a century that blends classic European architecture with modern life.

itinerary.title: WUHAN – JAKARTA
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Tanhualin, a historic area that combines classic-style buildings with cafés, art galleries and unique shops, an artistic and pleasant place to walk. Then visit Hubu Alley, the legendary food street known as a paradise of Wuhan snacks, where you can taste authentic local dishes. After lunch, you will be taken to the airport for the flight back to Jakarta. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. We hope you take home wonderful, unforgettable memories. itinerary.text: Today participants meet at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport Terminal 3 for the departure to Munich. Overnight on the plane.

itinerary.title: MUNICH – PRAGUE
itinerary.text: On arrival in Munich, continue to Prague, the capital of the Czech Republic, famous for its classic buildings and beautiful old town. In Prague, join a city tour visiting or passing famous landmarks such as Old Town Square, Charles Bridge, the Dancing House, the National Theatre, the Astronomical Clock, the Old-New Synagogue, St Nicholas Church, the National Museum and Wenceslas Square. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to rest.
itinerary.hotel: Holiday Inn Prague by IHG 4* / or similar

itinerary.title: PRAGUE – VIENNA
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, continue to Vienna, the capital of Austria, famous for its grand architecture and classic European feel. On the way, enjoy shopping at a McArthurGlen Designer Outlet. After shopping, continue to Vienna, where you will be taken to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: VIENNA – BUDAPEST – VIENNA
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, travel to Budapest, Hungary's beautiful capital known as the "Pearl of the Danube". In Budapest, join a city tour visiting or passing Fisherman's Bastion, Matthias Church, the Chain Bridge, Elisabeth Bridge, Buda Castle and the Parliament Building. After enjoying Budapest, return to Vienna for the night.

itinerary.title: VIENNA – SALZBURG
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, join a Vienna city tour visiting or passing famous icons such as Schönbrunn Palace, the Hofburg, the Upper Belvedere, the Parliament Building and the Strauss monument in the Stadtpark. Then continue to Salzburg, Mozart's birthplace, famous for its beautiful old town and Austrian scenery. In Salzburg, join a city tour visiting or passing the City Hall, the Old Town, Mozart's Birthplace and the Mirabell Gardens. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to rest.
itinerary.hotel: Hampton by Hilton Salzburg Messe 3* / or similar

itinerary.title: SALZBURG – HALLSTATT – INNSBRUCK
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, continue to Hallstatt, a lovely village on the UNESCO World Heritage list, famous for its stunning lake and mountain scenery. In Hallstatt, enjoy the village atmosphere at the Marktplatz central square, the old town and the Parish Church of the Assumption. Then continue to Innsbruck, where you will join a city tour visiting or passing the Golden Roof, the Hofburg, Innsbruck Cathedral and the City Hall. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: INNSBRUCK – ZURICH – LUCERNE
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, continue to Zurich, Switzerland's largest city, known as a financial centre with an elegant atmosphere. In Zurich, join a city tour visiting or passing Bahnhofstrasse, Limmatquai, the Rathaus (City Hall), Lake Zurich, the old guildhalls, the Fraumünster, the Grossmünster, Lindenhof Park and St Peter's Church. Then continue to Lucerne, where you will join a city tour visiting or passing the Chapel Bridge, the Lion Monument, the Old Town and Lake Lucerne. You will also visit the Bucherer shop. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: LUCERNE – GRINDELWALD – JUNGFRAUJOCH – LUCERNE
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, continue to Grindelwald for the journey up to the Jungfraujoch, known as the Top of Europe. Ride the Eiger Express cable car and enjoy the beautiful views of the Swiss Alps. At the Jungfraujoch, enjoy the panorama of eternal snow, mountains and the amazing Swiss atmosphere. Afterwards, return to Lucerne for the night.

itinerary.title: LUCERNE – MILAN
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, continue to Milan, Italy's famous fashion city. In Milan, join a city tour with photo stops at the Duomo, La Scala and the Leonardo da Vinci statue. You will also have time to enjoy the atmosphere and shop at the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, the classic shopping arcade that is one of Milan's icons. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today's city tour visits Kiyomizu-dera, a historic Buddhist temple in Kyoto also called the "Temple of Pure Water". A UNESCO World Heritage Site, it is famous for its great wooden stage built without nails and its views across all four seasons. Continue to Nagoya for photo stops at the Nagoya TV Tower and Oasis 21, an iconic landmark in central Nagoya built in 2002 with a design resembling a spaceship. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.

itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today we head to the famously beautiful Mount Fuji (weather permitting, we go up to the 5th Station). Continue to Iyashi-no-Sato, a traditional Japanese village on the west shore of Lake Saiko, one of the Fuji Five Lakes. Then visit Oshino Hakkai, a village famous for its eight spring-fed ponds of snowmelt water. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel for dinner, with the chance to enjoy an onsen hot spring bath.

Today's city tour visits Asakusa Kannon Temple, one of Japan's famous temples, then Nakamise Street for Japanese souvenirs, with a photo stop with the Tokyo Skytree in the background. Then shopping in Ginza. Afterwards, we head to Odaiba (meaning "fort"), an artificial island in Tokyo, for photo stops at the Statue of Liberty replica, the Gundam statue and the Rainbow Bridge. At the right time, you will be taken to Narita International Airport for the flight to Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: JAKARTA – INCHEON
itinerary.text: Today participants meet at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport Terminal 3 for the departure to Incheon.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL INCHEON – BUSAN CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: On arrival at Incheon International Airport, our friendly guide will meet us and we head to Busan. We go straight to the beautiful Haeundae Beach, on the edge of the city centre, and ride the Haeundae Sky Capsule train, then visit Haedong Yonggungsa Temple, set right by the sea. We also enjoy Busan by night as we pass the Gwangan Bridge. Hotel check-in.

itinerary.title: BUSAN CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. We shop at Gukje Market, BIFF Square and Jagalchi Market, the area famous for the BIFF (Busan International Film Festival) street. Then on to Gamcheon Culture Village, known as the "Machu Picchu of Korea" for its colourful, artistic houses that are a feast for the eyes. Next, we visit the Oryukdo Skywalk, a U-shaped glass bridge that juts out over the sea.

itinerary.title: BUSAN – SEOUL
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then we travel back to Seoul. Today we visit a ski resort (photo stop; ski equipment not included). Then on to COEX Mall in Gangnam, where we can visit the Starfield Library, a huge and popular library in the middle of the mall. Hotel check-in.

itinerary.title: SEOUL CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. We visit a national ginseng centre and a K-cosmetics shop, one of Korea's top cosmetics centres. Today we also visit Lotte World theme park (one-day pass included), Korea's largest and most famous indoor theme park. Then we pass Cheonggyecheon Stream on the way to Dongdaemun for shopping.

itinerary.title: SEOUL CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. We visit a health care shop (red pine) and an amethyst showcase. Today we visit N Seoul Tower, where we can hang a love lock. We also visit Gyeongbokgung Palace, exploring it while wearing hanbok. Then shopping at a duty-free shop, and in the evening free time for shopping or Korean street food in Myeongdong.

itinerary.title: INCHEON – JAKARTA
itinerary.text: This morning, before going to Incheon Airport, we visit a local supermarket for souvenirs and breakfast, then you will be taken to the airport for the flight home to Jakarta. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. We hope you take home wonderful, unforgettable memories. See you on your next journey. MINIMUM DEPARTURE: 25 ADULT PARTICIPANTS

itinerary.text: Today participants meet at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport Terminal 3 for the departure to Taipei. On arrival at Taoyuan International Airport, you will be taken to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: TAOYUAN – SUN MOON LAKE – TAICHUNG
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today we visit Sun Moon Lake, Taiwan's largest lake, and cruise around it by ferry, then visit Wen Wu Temple and the Thao aboriginal village (King of Mao). Then continue to Taichung, where you will be taken to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: TAICHUNG – CHIAYI – TAINAN – KAOHSIUNG
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the National Taichung Theater and Rainbow Village, then continue to Chiayi for a photo stop at the High-Heel Wedding Church, then to Tainan for a photo stop at the Chimei Museum. Continue to Kaohsiung; in the evening, visit Ruifeng Night Market.

itinerary.title: KAOHSIUNG – TAITUNG
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the Spring and Autumn Pavilions and the Dragon and Tiger Pagodas on Lotus Pond, then Fo Guang Shan, the largest Buddhist temple in Taiwan. Continue to Taitung, where you can enjoy the hotel hot spring (bring suitable swimwear and personal items).

itinerary.title: TAITUNG – HUALIEN
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Mr Brown Avenue in Chishang, a famous cycling route through rice fields with beautiful mountain views (bike rental included). From Taitung we continue to Hualien. In the evening, visit Dongdamen Night Market.

itinerary.title: HUALIEN – SHIFEN – TAIPEI
itinerary.text: After breakfast, head to the Shifen area, visiting Jiufen village and then Shifen Old Street to release a sky lantern (lantern included, 1 lantern per 4 people). Then continue to Taipei, and in the evening visit the Ximending shopping area.

itinerary.title: TAIPEI – YEHLIU – TAIPEI
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit Yehliu Geopark, followed by a Taipei city tour visiting or passing the CKS Memorial Hall and the Presidential Office Building, plus visits to the Vigor Kobo pineapple cake store and Taipei 101 Mall (Taipei 101 Observatory not included, USD 25/person).

itinerary.title: JAKARTA – SINGAPORE
itinerary.text: Meet at Soekarno-Hatta Airport 3 hours before departure to start the journey to Türkiye on Singapore Airlines.

itinerary.title: SINGAPORE – ISTANBUL – BURSA
itinerary.text: On arrival in Istanbul, our friendly Indonesian-speaking guide will meet us and take us to the Blue Mosque, with its six minarets and blue tiles, a uniquely striking building, and the Hippodrome area. Then we take photos in front of Topkapi Palace (photo stop), a museum and library founded in 1465. In the afternoon, we take photos in front of Hagia Sophia Mosque and continue to Bursa. Hotel check-in and rest.

itinerary.title: BURSA – MT ULUDAG – KUSADASI
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then a Turkish delight shop for Turkish souvenirs. Then we visit the Grand Mosque, a historic Ottoman-style mosque with 20 domes and beautiful calligraphy inside. We also shop at the Silk Market. Afterwards we head to Mt Uludağ (return cable car included), one of Türkiye's most popular winter resort areas, with beautiful mountain views and a chance to enjoy the snow. Then we continue to Kuşadası, a coastal town famous for its lovely Aegean Sea views. Hotel check-in and rest.

itinerary.title: KUSADASI – PAMUKKALE
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then on to Şirince, a small village near Kuşadası famous for its vineyards and olive oil. Then a Turkish leather shop, selling the leather bags Türkiye is known for. At midday, we travel to Pamukkale and the nature park and viewpoint (photo stop), where you can photograph the beautiful white limestone landscape. Then we visit the Cotton Castle (photo stop), natural white travertine terraces filled with hot pools that look like a castle of cotton, one of Türkiye's most famous natural wonders. Hotel check-in and rest.

itinerary.title: PAMUKKALE – CAPPADOCIA
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. We start the day shopping at a textile outlet. Then we visit Sultanhanı Caravanserai (photo stop), a complex near Konya that was a hub of the old Silk Road trade. We continue to Cappadocia. Hotel check-in and rest.

itinerary.title: CAPPADOCIA
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel, then on to Pigeon Valley and Uçhisar Castle, with a unique valley of dovecotes carved into the rock and the tallest natural fortress in Cappadocia. Then we visit Göreme Valley and Panorama, a village built among beautiful rock formations with unique buildings. Next, Avanos and a pottery shop, a small town full of the clay crafts it is famous for. In the afternoon, we shop for Turkish carpets and jewellery before returning to the hotel to rest. [Optional: hot-air balloon flight (weather permitting).]

itinerary.title: CAPPADOCIA – ISTANBUL
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today we start at Salt Lake (photo stop), a vast salt lake on Türkiye's arid plateau, about 65 miles (105 km) northeast of Konya, where we can take photos of the stunning lake views. Then we continue to Istanbul. Hotel check-in and rest.

itinerary.title: ISTANBUL
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. We visit the Grand Bazaar, one of the largest and oldest covered markets in the world, with thousands of shops selling Turkish goods. Then we enjoy a Bosphorus cruise along the strait, with views of Ottoman palaces, grand mosques and the unique meeting of Europe and Asia. Then we explore Taksim Square, where Asian and European culture and traditions meet. Return to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: ISTANBUL – SINGAPORE
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, you will be taken to Istanbul Airport for the flight home via Singapore.

itinerary.title: SINGAPORE – JAKARTA
itinerary.text: Today you fly back to Jakarta. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. We hope you take home wonderful, unforgettable memories. See you on your next journey. *The order of the itinerary/cities may change depending on needs or conditions on the ground, as decided by the organiser. MINIMUM DEPARTURE: 20 ADULT PARTICIPANTS
