itinerary.title: JAKARTA – DUBAI
itinerary.text: Today your journey to Türkiye begins! Participants meet at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport Terminal 3 for check-in and departure. Get ready for a trip full of great experiences and the historic charm that awaits in this land of two continents.

itinerary.title: DUBAI – ISTANBUL – BURSA
itinerary.text: On arrival in Istanbul, continue straight to Bursa, a historic Turkish city rich in cultural heritage and beautiful scenery. Enjoy the Turkish landscape along the way. In Bursa, shop for Turkish delight, the famous soft, sweet treat in many flavours that makes a great gift for family and friends. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.
itinerary.hotel: Görükle Oruç Hotel & Spa / or similar

itinerary.title: BURSA CITY TOUR – CUMALIKIZIK – KUSADASI
itinerary.text: Today, enjoy Bursa, a city rich in Ottoman history and heritage. Start at the Grand Mosque and the Green Mosque, two historic buildings with classic Ottoman architecture and the city's main attractions. Then visit Cumalıkızık, a historic Ottoman village with a traditional Turkish atmosphere and well-preserved Ottoman houses. Don't miss shopping at the Silk Market, Bursa's famous silk bazaar, with a wide range of Turkish silk fabrics and products that make lovely souvenirs. Then continue to Kuşadası for the night.

itinerary.title: KUSADASI – PAMUKKALE
itinerary.text: Today, continue to Pamukkale, an iconic Turkish destination famous for its natural beauty. In Pamukkale, stop for photos at the ancient city of Hierapolis, a Roman city of great historical value. Then admire the Cotton Castle, natural white terraces formed by hot-spring minerals and one of Türkiye's most famous landmarks. The day also includes a visit to a leather factory outlet, where you can see Turkish leather goods and a fashion show of quality leather products. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.

itinerary.title: PAMUKKALE – CAPPADOCIA
itinerary.text: Today, continue to Cappadocia, a spectacular region famous for its unique landscape and fascinating history. On the way, visit the Mevlana Mausoleum in Konya, a historic site and a spiritual and cultural symbol of Türkiye. Then stop for photos at Sultanhanı Caravanserai, a historic inn where merchants and caravans once rested on the Silk Road. The day also includes shopping at a textile outlet, with Turkish textiles that make attractive souvenirs.

itinerary.title: CAPPADOCIA
itinerary.text: Today, discover the wonders of Cappadocia, famous for its unique landscape, rock valleys and stunning underground cities. For an unforgettable experience, an optional hot-air balloon tour lets you see Cappadocia from above at sunrise. Then visit Çardak Underground City, which tells the story of how Cappadocians lived in the past. Next, enjoy the amazing views at Göreme Valley and Panorama, then visit Uçhisar village, Paşabağ Valley, Pigeon Valley and Devrent Valley, famous for their unique rock formations and spectacular scenery. Towards the end of the day, visit Avanos, the village famous for Cappadocian pottery. Complete the day at a Turkish handicraft carpet factory and see the beauty of traditional Turkish carpets.

itinerary.title: CAPPADOCIA – MT ERCIYES – ISTANBUL
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today, leave Cappadocia for Mt Erciyes, one of Türkiye's highest mountains and a popular natural destination. Enjoy the beautiful mountain scenery and cool air. In winter, the area is also one of Türkiye's favourite ski destinations. After Mt Erciyes, continue to Istanbul, ready to enjoy again the blend of European and Asian culture that makes Türkiye special. Overnight in Istanbul. Note: cable car and ski equipment are not included in the programme.

itinerary.title: ISTANBUL BOSPHORUS CRUISE
itinerary.text: Today, enjoy Istanbul on a Bosphorus cruise along the strait that both divides and connects Europe and Asia. Admire the city from the boat, with historic buildings, the shoreline and the captivating atmosphere of the Bosphorus. Then visit Taksim Square, one of Istanbul's liveliest and most popular areas. Afterwards, enjoy shopping at the Grand Bazaar, one of the largest and most famous traditional markets in Istanbul, with souvenirs, handicrafts, spices, jewellery and all kinds of Turkish gifts. Then return to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: ISTANBUL – SINGAPORE
itinerary.text: After breakfast at the hotel, enjoy an Istanbul city tour visiting the Roman Hippodrome, the historic square that hosted shows and celebrations in the Roman Empire. Continue to the Blue Mosque, an Istanbul landmark famous for its grand architecture and beautiful interior. Then stop for photos at Hagia Sophia, Istanbul's historic icon that has witnessed many civilisations and one of the most famous buildings in Türkiye. After the tour, it is time to say goodbye to Türkiye. You will be taken to the airport for the flight back to Jakarta via Dubai.

itinerary.text: Today you arrive in Jakarta. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. We hope you take home wonderful, unforgettable memories. See you on your next journey. MINIMUM DEPARTURE: 20 ADULT PARTICIPANTS

itinerary.title: DA NANG – BA NA HILLS – DA NANG

itinerary.text: Today your journey to Europe begins! Participants meet at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport Terminal 3 for check-in and departure to Zurich, Switzerland, via Doha.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL ZURICH AIRPORT – FREIBURG
itinerary.text: On arrival in Zurich, head straight to Lucerne for photo stops at Lake Lucerne, the Lion Monument, Lucerne Old Town and the Chapel Bridge. Then continue to Rheinfall for a photo stop at the Rhine Falls. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.

itinerary.title: FREIBURG – STRASBOURG – LUXEMBOURG – METZ
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today, travel to Strasbourg, capital of France's Grand Est region. There, enjoy a city orientation with photo stops at the Palais Rohan, Strasbourg Cathedral and the historic Petite France quarter, famous for its Alsatian-style houses and beautiful canals. Then continue to Luxembourg for photo stops at Notre-Dame Cathedral and the Grand Ducal Palace, the official residence of the Grand Duke of Luxembourg. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.

itinerary.title: METZ – LA VALLÉE – PARIS
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today, head to La Vallée Village, one of the most popular outlet shopping destinations in France. Enjoy shopping for international brands and well-known fashion labels such as Gucci, Prada, Burberry and more. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.
itinerary.hotel: Ibis Besançon Centre La City 3* / or similar

itinerary.title: PARIS – BRUSSELS
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today, join a city tour of Paris, the French capital famous as one of the most romantic cities in the world. Stop for photos at the Champs-Élysées, the Eiffel Tower, Place de la Concorde, the Louvre and the Arc de Triomphe, and enjoy the atmosphere along the banks of the Seine. Then continue to Brussels, the capital of Belgium, where you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.
itinerary.hotel: Best Western Brussels South 3* / or similar

itinerary.title: BRUSSELS – COLOGNE – MONHEIM
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today, enjoy a city tour of Brussels, Belgium's capital, with photo stops at the Grand Place, the historic square with grand architecture, and the Manneken Pis, the iconic statue that is one of the city's symbols. Then continue to Cologne for photo stops at Cologne Cathedral, Great St Martin Church and the Central Mosque. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.
itinerary.hotel: Hey Lou Monheim am Rhein 3* / or similar

itinerary.title: MONHEIM – VOLENDAM – ZAANSE SCHANS – AMSTERDAM
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today, visit Volendam, a traditional fishing village with a classic Dutch atmosphere. Explore the fishermen's village and enjoy the pretty harbour, traditional houses and coastal village charm. Then continue to Zaanse Schans, famous for its traditional Dutch windmills. Enjoy a photo stop at the windmills and capture the moment with the iconic mills and wooden Dutch houses. Afterwards, you will be taken to the hotel to check in and rest.

itinerary.title: ZURICH – DOHA – JAKARTA
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today we stop for photos at the Fraumünster and go shopping on Bahnhofstrasse, Zurich's luxury shopping street in the city centre. Then you will be taken to the airport for the flight home via Doha.

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN JAKARTA
itinerary.text: Today you arrive in Jakarta. Thank you for travelling with Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. We hope you take home wonderful, unforgettable memories. See you on your next journey. MINIMUM DEPARTURE: 20 ADULT PARTICIPANTS

itinerary.title: JAKARTA – JEDDAH – MADINAH
itinerary.text: Pilgrims meet 4 hours before departure wearing the travel batik and hand their suitcases to the airport handling team, and receive their passports, tickets, luggage name tags, ID cards and scarves. After immigration, fly with Qatar Airways/Etihad Airways to Jeddah via a transit airport. On arrival in Jeddah, after immigration and baggage claim, pilgrims are taken to Madinah to check in at the hotel and rest.
itinerary.hotel: Golden Tulip Al Ansar 3* / or similar

itinerary.title: MADINAH
itinerary.text: After the dawn (Subuh) prayer, pilgrims visit the area around the Prophet's Mosque (Masjid Nabawi). After the Isha prayer and dinner, visit the grave of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and his companions, accompanied by a female mutawifah for women and a male mutawif for men. Then pray and make supplications in the Raudhah (subject to the permit schedule). The rest of the time is for worship at Masjid Nabawi (free programme).
itinerary.hotel: Golden Tulip Al Ansar 3* / or similar

itinerary.title: MADINAH
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a ziyarah tour of Madinah visiting Mount Uhud, Quba Mosque, Qiblatain Mosque and the date market. Return to the hotel and spend time in worship at Masjid Nabawi.
itinerary.hotel: Golden Tulip Al Ansar 3* / or similar

itinerary.title: MADINAH – MAKKAH
itinerary.text: After breakfast, take the sunnah bath for ihram and check out. After the Dhuhr prayer and lunch, travel to Makkah by high-speed train. Take the miqat at Bir Ali Mosque and make the intention for umrah. In Makkah, leave your belongings at the hotel and have dinner, then perform the umrah. After the umrah, return to the hotel to rest.

itinerary.title: MAKKAH
itinerary.text: After breakfast, spend time in worship at Masjidil Haram (free programme).

itinerary.title: MAKKAH
itinerary.text: After breakfast, a ziyarah tour of Makkah visiting Jabal Nur, Jabal Rahmah, Muzdalifah, Mina, Jabal Tsur, Namirah Mosque, the Al-Wahyu Museum and Ja'ranah Mosque, ending at Tan'im (Aisha) Mosque for those taking the miqat for a second umrah. Those not doing a second umrah spend time in worship at Masjidil Haram.

itinerary.title: MAKKAH – TAIF
itinerary.text: City tour to Taif. In the evening, pilgrims pack for the journey home the next day.

itinerary.title: MAKKAH – JEDDAH
itinerary.text: After the dawn prayer and the farewell tawaf (tawaf wada'), check out of the hotel. Four hours before departure, pilgrims go to Jeddah Airport for the flight to Jakarta (meals on board).

itinerary.title: ARRIVAL IN JAKARTA
itinerary.text: God willing, arrive safely in Jakarta. Thank you for entrusting your pilgrimage to Tabernacle Ways Tour and Travel. May your umrah be accepted (mabrur).

itinerary.title: JAKARTA – KUALA LUMPUR – INCHEON
itinerary.text: Participants meet at Soekarno-Hatta International Airport Terminal 3 to fly to Seoul via Kuala Lumpur on Malaysia Airlines (CGK 12:15 – KUL 15:20 MH716 or CGK 18:25 – KUL 21:35 MH722, then KUL 23:15 – ICN 06:30+1 MH066).

itinerary.title: INCHEON – SKI RESORT – NAMI ISLAND
itinerary.text: On arrival at Incheon International Airport, head to a ski resort to enjoy the snow of a Korean winter (ski equipment and clothing not included). Then visit Nami Island, the pretty island where the drama Winter Sonata was filmed.

itinerary.title: EVERLAND – SUWON
itinerary.text: Visit Everland, the largest theme park in South Korea. Continue to Suwon Hwaseong Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site from the Joseon Dynasty, then the impressive Starfield Library Suwon. In the late afternoon, return to Seoul to rest.

itinerary.title: SEOUL CITY TOUR
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit a national ginseng centre and a K-cosmetics shop. City tour to Gyeongbokgung Palace and the National Folk Museum. In the afternoon, shop at Dongdaemun fashion town before watching the Painters show.

itinerary.title: SEOUL EXPERIENCE
itinerary.text: Visit a healthcare shop (red pine) and an amethyst shop, then a kimbap-making experience. Continue to N Seoul Tower (outdoor observation area), Itaewon, a duty-free shop and the buzz of Myeongdong.

itinerary.title: INCHEON – JAKARTA
itinerary.text: After breakfast, stop at a local supermarket for Korean souvenirs, then transfer to the airport (ICN 11:05 – KUL 16:45 MH067, then KUL 17:55 – CGK 19:05 MH725 or KUL 22:30 – CGK 23:40 MH727).
